problem_fits.caveat: This is the vendor's own compliance self-assessment, not an independent legal ruling, and it does not establish anything about the named competitors' techniques; the research problem's fingerprinting concern is directed at other tools, not an audited gap in Simple Analytics.
problem_fits.why: Simple Analytics documents no cookies/trackers/consent and a non-personal data scope excluding device-fingerprinting identifiers, and bases its GDPR/ePrivacy/UK GDPR/PECR compliance and DPA exemption on that same scope, directly responding to the disputed claim that 'privacy-friendly' analytics still requires consent.

problem_fits.caveat: The Free plan is scoped 'for hobby sites,' requires displaying a badge, and caps at 5 websites and 1 month of history, so it may not suit a professional agency's production client sites without upgrading to the €20/month Self-serve plan.
